subject: English
title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class III

source.read: SCERT Tamil Nadu, TNCF 2017 syllabus, English language, Standards 1 to 10 (published in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette), read through a copy hosted by an exam-coaching site
source.note: UNOFFICIAL COPY OF AN OFFICIAL SOURCE. The state's own syllabus (TNCF 2017, marked draft), read through a text summary of a third-party copy of the gazette pages; the Standard 9 page was only partly readable. The Samacheer Kalvi textbooks follow it term by term.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Listens to songs, stories, folk tales and poems and follows what happens.
Follows the order of events and cause and effect in a story heard.
Describes people, places, animals and things with three or four details.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Holds a conversation of two or three turns, using polite forms.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads short illustrated texts, including information texts.
Puts words in alphabetical order and uses a picture dictionary.
Writes two or three connected sentences from a picture.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses past and present verbs in basic sentences.
Uses adjectives of colour, shape and size.
